# R&G Collections (Atelier & Bespoke Menswear)

> Contemporary luxury menswear, handcrafted leather footwear, bespoke Senator suits, and master-crafted Nigerian ceremonial native wear. Defined by style, designed for you.

## Brand Identity & Overview
- **Brand Name**: R&G Collections (also known as R & G, R&G Atelier)
- **Tagline**: Fashion That Moves With You | Defined by style. Designed for you.
- **Website**: https://r-g-three.vercel.app
- **Industry**: Luxury Menswear, Bespoke Tailoring, Premium Footwear & High Fashion
- **Locations Served**: Lagos, Akure, Owo / Achievers University, and nationwide express shipping across Nigeria and international destinations.
- **Currencies**: Nigerian Naira (NGN), USD, GBP, EUR

## Product Offerings
1. **Ceremonial & Native Menswear**:
   - Master-crafted Senator suits with imperial gold and obsidian accents.
   - Luxury Agbada ensembles and bespoke Kaftans.
   - Contemporary minimalist ethnic tailoring with hand-finished piping and embroidery.
2. **Contemporary Luxury Essentials**:
   - Monochromatic oversized heavyweight hoodies and tailored joggers.
   - Structured luxury overshirts, linen resort shirts, and evening knitwear.
   - Minimalist casual tailoring for the modern gentleman.
3. **Footwear & Leather Goods**:
   - Handcrafted Italian leather Chelsea boots, monk straps, and loafers.
   - Clean architectural leather luxury sneakers.
   - Full-grain calfskin belts, cardholders, and weekend duffels.
